[NGST.1.2] **Building from source instead of a tarball.** The `Makefile` in
`runtime/src/libds/`, generated and committed with the tree, builds
`runtime/src/libds/libds.a` there: the same archive the tarball ships as
`lib/libds.a`. Run it from that directory, with the tools it invokes on the
path (a C compiler, a C++17 compiler, `protoc-c`) and RE2's headers available.
It takes its version from the tree's `VERSION` file, so the archive loads
artefacts compiled by the same release ([LDET.1.10]).
